name: Dark Euphoria Supersaw
desc: FUSES trance's supersaw euphoria (chords.trance.supersaw) with gqom's dark C-minor chant world (pad.gqom.dark_chant): an anthem hook that refuses to resolve major - festival hands-up over a township stomp.

code.full: note("<[c4 c4 eb4 g4] [f4 eb4 c4 ~] [g4 g4 bb4 g4] [f4 eb4 d4 c4]>").add(note(${root})).s("supersaw").detune(${detune}).attack(.01).decay(.28).sustain(.25).release(.12).lpf(sine.range(1800,3400).slow(16)).lpq(2).shape(.5).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.7,${gain}).fast(4)).room(.3).pan(sine.range(.42,.58).slow(10)).every(8, x=>x.add(note(12))).orbit(5).play()
code.peak: note("<[c4 c4 eb4 g4 c5 g4 eb4 c4] [f4 eb4 c4 f4 g4 bb4 g4 f4]>").add(note(${root})).superimpose(x=>x.add(note(12)).gain(.6)).s("supersaw").detune(${detune}*1.3).attack(.008).decay(.25).sustain(.25).release(.1).lpf(sine.range(2200,4200).slow(8)).lpq(2).shape(.55).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.72,${gain}).fast(4)).room(.25).pan(sine.range(.38,.62).slow(7)).orbit(5).play()
